newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 16.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Chinese President Jiang Zemin and French President Jacques Chirac meet, agree to build comprehensive partnership
- Front-page speech of President Jiang Zemin calls for revival of Communist Party tradition of hard work and thrift to end indulgence in luxury and extravagance.
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Package of agreements and exchanges of notes signed in Beijing yesterday between the Chinese and French governments.
- President Jiang Zemin tells Alan Greenspan, chairman of Board of U.S. Federal Reserve that China has curbed inflation
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Changhong Electronic Group boosts sales 99 times from 1985 to 1996
- State Information Centre says prosperity index in second quarter may drop slightly temporarily
CHINA BUSINESS DAILY
- Spot check on corn seed in first quarter shows 47.9 percent up to standard, up by 38.1 percentage points from last year
ECONOMIC DAILY
- National grain price index in April was unchanged from March, while edible oil price index up 3.0 percentage points year-on-year
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- China to launch satellite to monitor crops
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY DAILY
- Private demand for cars in 1997 seen to grow by 48.9 percent
CHINA DAILY
- Premier Li Peng returns winding up official goodwill visit to Zambia, Mozambique, Gabon, Cameroon, Nigeria and Tanzania and a working visit to Seychelles, described as "fruitful and successful"

- Construction starts on Ling'ao nuclear power station in Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, second of its kind in Guangdong. Ministry of Power Industry, China National Nuclear Power Corp and Guangdong Province will invest a combined $400 million.
- Wei Jianxing, secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of Communist Party, urges anti-corruption campaign.
